plan.notes: Source: 'BA Modern Languages: Spanish Education - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Modern Languages), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. The plan prints 'EDUC 2003/2000 Introduction to Education/Lab' (3 credits) in Spring Semester 2 - kept verbatim. The plan prints 'S ED 4023 Residency I (E) or EDUC 4043 Designing Assessments for General and Special Populations (O)' in Spring Semesters 4 and 6; 'S ED 4023 Residency I' is the first-listed (even-year) option - kept with code S ED 4023. The plan prints 'SPAN 4823 Spanish Literature II (E) or SPAN 3193 Spanish-American Literature II (O)' in Spring Semester 6; 'SPAN 4823 Spanish Literature II' is the first-listed (even-year) option - kept with code SPAN 4823. The plan prints 'EDUC 3713 Methods and Materials Foreign Language K-12 (E) or Elective (O)' in Spring Semester 6; 'EDUC 3713 Methods and Materials Foreign Language K-12' is the first-listed (even-year) option - kept with code EDUC 3713. The plan prints 'FL 4100 Oral Proficiency Interview' (0 credits) in Fall Semester 7 - kept verbatim with 0 credits. Annotations printed in the plan: 'Praxis I and Admission to Teacher Education' (Fall Semester 3) and 'Praxis II/Admission to Student Teaching' (Fall Semester 7).
